title: Columbia’s collaboration network
description: A fixed force-directed view of coauthorship among the 80 researchers with the most Columbia-affiliated works in the 2021–2024 snapshot. Search or select a researcher to trace their direct collaborators. Circle area represents qualifying affiliated works; line width represents shared works regardless of affiliation.

issues.problem: The selected one-work tie is still faint. Its endpoints stand out, but the line itself is easy to miss.
issues.fix: Increase the selected tie’s contrast while preserving its data-encoded width.

issues.problem: The tie detail card reads “1 distinct shared works.”
issues.fix: Use “work” for a count of one and “works” for other counts.

reviews.summary: The default view accounts for all 80 researchers and 208 ties, distinguishes the two connected components by color, and places the 15 isolates in a clearly labeled area. The legends explain circle area, line width, and why layout distance should not be read as a scale. Default labels are legible without overlap. Automated checks confirm hover, selection, highlighting, and both parameter updates; the selected screenshot shows the exact shared-work count.
